causal_synchronization.rule: latest scalar record satisfying t_scalar <= t_camera
causal_synchronization.timestamp_domain: MCAP log_time (bag-record time) for all three streams

integrity.classification: complete, footer-valid MCAP with matching metadata and readable required streams

active_driving_candidate_window.method: longest contiguous run of finite, exactly nonzero raw speed values

active_driving_candidate_windows.method: contiguous run of finite, exactly nonzero raw speed values

float64_decode_validation.method: mcap_ros2 decode independently compared with direct CDR Float64 unpack

sign_and_stationary_counts.stationary_definition: exact zero only; diagnostic, not a permanent filter

float64_decode_validation.method: mcap_ros2 decode independently compared with direct CDR Float64 unpack

causal_speed_relation.rule: latest speed MCAP log_time satisfying t_speed <= t_steering

driving_phase_definition.active_nonzero_speed: within the first-to-last nonzero envelope with causal speed nonzero
driving_phase_definition.stationary_prefix: before the first finite, exactly nonzero speed record
driving_phase_definition.stationary_suffix: after the last finite, exactly nonzero speed record
driving_phase_definition.zero_speed_inside_active_envelope: within that envelope with causal speed exactly zero

out_of_range_reconciliation.interpretation: These are recorded normalized values whose raw magnitudes exceed the physical radian numeric limit before the required whole-stream rescaling; they are not physical-radian range violations.
out_of_range_reconciliation.repeated_consecutive_plateau_definition: at least two consecutive recorded values outside the unscaled physical numeric range, equal after rounding to 6 decimals

probable_saturation.assessment: no repeated near-limit physical-radian saturation value detected

range_check.assessment: all converted physical-radian values are within the confirmed approximate range

recorded_to_radians.evidence: User-confirmed on 2026-08-26: these bags mistakenly stored steering on a -1 to +1 scale and the entire stream must be rescaled to the physical +/-0.35 rad range.

three_frame_temporal_readiness.architecture_assessment: typical complete-bag spacing is compatible, but diagnostic >0.120 s gaps require a real-data policy

timestamp_domain.reason: Float64 has no header; use one causal MCAP bag-record timestamp domain for camera, steering, and speed.
